answer_1.quote: We evaluate 7 open-and closed-weights LLMs on both identifying puns and providing supporting rationales
answer_1.outputs: semi-structured rationales including pun words, alternative words, and their senses

answer_2.quote: We quantify the alignment between the LLM-predicted pun pair (w′p,w′a) and the true pun/alternative word pair (wp,wa) using the pun pair agreement (PPA) metric

answer_4.quote: To precisely characterize the model's mistakes in the categories above, we conducted an error analysis with five native English speakers specifically hired for this task
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answered multiple-choice questions assessing legitimacy of word-sense associations, context support, pun word pair suitability, and sense diversity
